联合质量、密度与分布函数
Joint PMFs, PDFs, and CDFs

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Understand what is meant by a joint pmf, pdf and cdf of two random variables.
  2. Be able to compute probabilities and marginals from a joint pmf or pdf.
  3. Be able to test whether two random variables are independent.

本讲要求理解两个随机变量的联合 pmf、pdf 和 cdf, 会由联合分布计算事件概率和边缘分布, 并能检查两个变量是否独立.

学习顺序是「联合表或联合密度 → 事件概率 → 边缘分布 → 乘积判据」. 协方差和相关则进一步描述依赖关系.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1

In science and in real life, we are often interested in two (or more) random variables at the same time. For example, we might measure the height and weight of giraffes, or the IQ and birthweight of children, or the frequency of exercise and the rate of heart disease in adults, or the level of air pollution and rate of respiratory illness in cities, or the number of Facebook friends and the age of Facebook members.

Think: What relationship would you expect in each of the five examples above? Why?

In such situations the random variables have a joint distribution that allows us to compute probabilities of events involving both variables and understand the relationship between the variables. This is simplest when the variables are independent. When they are not, we use covariance and correlation as measures of the nature of the dependence between them.

现实中常要同时研究多个变量, 例如身高与体重、IQ 与出生体重、锻炼与心脏病、污染与呼吸道疾病、好友数与年龄.

联合分布同时描述这些变量, 可以计算 P((X,Y)∈A), 也保留变量之间关系的信息. 独立时最容易处理; 不独立时, 再用协方差和相关描述依赖的方向和强弱.

这些例子只能提示可能的关系, 相关方向和因果机制仍要由数据与研究设计判断.

3.1 离散情形
3.1 Discrete case

Pages 1–2

Suppose X and Y are two discrete random variables and that X takes values {x1​,x2​,…,xn​} and Y takes values {y1​,y2​,…,ym​}. The ordered pair (X,Y) take values in the product {(x1​,y1​),(x1​,y2​),…,(xn​,ym​)}. The joint probability mass function (joint pmf) of X and Y is the function p(xi​,yj​) giving the probability of the joint outcome X=xi​,Y=yj​.

Example 1. Roll two dice. Let X be the value on the first die and let Y be the value on the second die. Then both X and Y take values 1 to 6 and the joint pmf is p(i,j)=1/36 for all i and j between 1 and 6.

X∖Y123456
11/361/361/361/361/361/36
21/361/361/361/361/361/36
31/361/361/361/361/361/36
41/361/361/361/361/361/36
51/361/361/361/361/361/36
61/361/361/361/361/361/36

Joint probability mass function 联合概率质量函数给出每个有序对 (xi​,yj​) 的概率, 即 P(X=xi​,Y=yj​). 两个变量的可能取值组成乘积样本空间.

两枚公平骰子的 36 个有序对各为 1/36, 所以表中每格相同. 每格是一个联合结果, 不是两个独立事件概率相加的结果.

Page 2

Example 2. Roll two dice. Let X be the value on the first die and let T be the total on both dice. Here is the joint probability table:

X∖T23456789101112
11/361/361/361/361/361/3600000
201/361/361/361/361/361/360000
3001/361/361/361/361/361/36000
40001/361/361/361/361/361/3600
500001/361/361/361/361/361/360
6000001/361/361/361/361/361/36

A joint probability mass function must satisfy two properties:

  1. 0≤p(xi​,yj​)≤1
  2. The total probability is 1. We can express this as a double sum: ∑i=1n​∑j=1m​p(xi​,yj​)=1.

第二张表把第二个坐标换成总和 T=X+Y. 同一批 36 个有序对仍在, 只是按「第一枚点数 x, 点数和 t」重新标记.

例如 p(4,2)=0, 因为第一枚为 4 时总和不可能为 2; p(1,7)=1/36, 因为第一枚为 1 时, 第二枚必须为 6 才能和为 7. 表中 0 表示该联合结果不可能发生.

联合 pmf 每项须在 0 和 1 之间, 全部格子的总和为 1.

3.2 连续情形
3.2 Continuous case

Page 3

The continuous case is essentially the same as the discrete case: we just replace discrete sets of values by continuous intervals, the joint probability mass function by a joint probability density function, and the sums by integrals.

If X takes values in [a,b] and Y takes values in [c,d] then the pair (X,Y) takes values in the product [a,b]×[c,d]. The joint probability density function (joint pdf) of X and Y is a function f(x,y) giving the probability density at (x,y). That is, the probability that (X,Y) is in a small rectangle of width dx and height dy around (x,y) is f(x,y)dxdy.

A joint probability density function must satisfy two properties:

  1. 0≤f(x,y)
  2. The total probability is 1. We now express this as a double integral: ∫cd​∫ab​f(x,y)dxdy=1.

Note: as with the pdf of a single random variable, the joint pdf f(x,y) can take values greater than 1; it is a probability density, not a probability.

In 18.05 we won’t expect you to be experts at double integration. Here’s what we will expect.

  • You should understand double integrals conceptually as double sums.
  • You should be able to compute double integrals over rectangles.
  • For a non-rectangular region, when f(x,y)=c is constant, you should know that the double integral is the same as c× (the area of the region).

Joint probability density function 联合概率密度函数本身不是概率. 小矩形内的近似概率是 f(x,y)dxdy, 所以密度可以大于 1, 但整个取值区域上的二重积分必须为 1.

读图:大矩形是取值范围, 小矩形的边长是 dx,dy. 从离散到连续的对应是「格子概率 → 密度乘面积元, 双重求和 → 二重积分」.

若密度为常数 c, 区域概率就是 c 乘区域面积. 本讲不要求复杂二重积分, 但要会矩形积分和常数密度面积法.

联合事件与累积分布
Joint Events and the Joint CDF

例 3: 离散事件
Example 3. Discrete events

Page 4

In Example 1, describe the event B= ‘Y−X≥2’ and find its probability.

Solution: We can describe B as a set of (X,Y) pairs:

B={(1,3),(1,4),(1,5),(1,6),(2,4),(2,5),(2,6),(3,5),(3,6),(4,6)}.

We can also describe it visually. The event B consists of the outcomes in the shaded squares.

The probability of B is the sum of the probabilities in the orange shaded squares, so P(B)=10/36.

事件 Y−X≥2 包含 10 个有序对, 每个概率为 1/36, 所以 P(B)=10/36=5/18.

读图:逐格检查第二个骰子点数减第一个是否至少为 2. 差为 2、3、4、5 的格子都要包括, 不能只数差为 2 的那条对角线.

例 4: 连续事件
Example 4. A continuous event

Page 4

Suppose X and Y both take values in [0,1] with uniform density f(x,y)=1. Visualize the event ‘X>Y’ and find its probability.

Solution: Jointly X and Y take values in the unit square. The event ‘X>Y’ corresponds to the shaded lower-right triangle below. Since the density is constant, the probability is just the fraction of the total area taken up by the event. In this case, it is clearly 0.5.

直线 y=x 把单位正方形分成面积相等的两个三角形. X>Y 是右下三角形, 面积为 1/2, 密度又为 1, 所以概率是 1/2.

边界 X=Y 在连续分布中概率为 0, 是否写入不等号不改变答案.

例 5: 非常数密度
Example 5. A nonconstant density

Page 5

Suppose X and Y both take values in [0,1] with density f(x,y)=4xy. Show f(x,y) is a valid joint pdf, visualize the event A= ‘X<0.5 and Y>0.5’ and find its probability.

Solution: Jointly X and Y take values in the unit square. The event A is just the upper-left-hand quadrant.

To show f(x,y) is a valid joint pdf we must check that it is positive (which it clearly is) and that the total probability is 1.

Total probability=∫01​∫01​4xydxdy=∫01​[2x2y]01​dy=∫01​2ydy=1.QED

密度 4xy 在正方形内非负, 且 ∫01​∫01​4xydxdy=1, 所以是合法联合 pdf.

二重积分可以先对 x 积分得到 2y, 再对 y 积分得 1; 也可分解为 (∫01​2xdx)(∫01​2ydy).

合法联合密度的两项检查. 先在完整取值区域上确认 f(x,y)≥0, 再确认 ∬f(x,y)dxdy=1. 不能只检查某个矩形子区域, 也不能用事件概率代替总概率.

如果密度是 g(x)h(y) 的乘积, 全区域又是矩形, 二重积分可以拆成两个单积分相乘. 这既能加快归一化, 也能随后帮助判断独立性.

归一化通过后再算具体事件. 事件区域只是全区域的一部分, 概率仍要按同一密度积分, 不能因为区域形状规则就直接取面积.

Page 5

Because the density is not constant we must compute an integral to find the probability.

P(A)=∫00.5​∫0.51​4xydydx=∫00.5​[2xy2]0.51​dx=∫00.5​23x​dx=163​.

事件 A 是 X<0.5,Y>0.5 的矩形. 虽然面积是 1/4, 概率却不是 1/4, 因为密度在右上方更大.

实际计算可分解为 (∫01/2​2xdx)(∫1/21​2ydy)=(1/4)(3/4)=3/16. 事件区域形状和密度权重必须一起看.

3.4 联合累积分布函数
3.4 Joint cumulative distribution function

Page 5

Suppose X and Y are jointly-distributed random variables. We will use the notation ‘X≤x,Y≤y’ to mean the event ‘X≤x and Y≤y’. The joint cumulative distribution function (joint cdf) is defined as

F(x,y)=P(X≤x,Y≤y).

Continuous case: If X and Y are continuous random variables with joint density f(x,y) over the range [a,b]×[c,d] then the joint cdf is given by the double integral:

F(x,y)=∫cy​∫ax​f(u,v)dudv.

To recover the joint pdf, we differentiate the joint cdf. Because there are two variables we need to use partial derivatives:

f(x,y)=∂x∂y∂2F​(x,y).

Discrete case: If X and Y are discrete random variables with joint pmf p(xi​,yj​) then the joint cdf is give by the double sum

F(x,y)=xi​≤x∑​yj​≤y∑​p(xi​,yj​).

Joint cumulative distribution function 联合累积分布函数 F(x,y) 表示 X≤x,Y≤y 的概率, 即左下方矩形 (−∞,x]×(−∞,y] 的概率.

连续情形对密度在该区域积分, 离散情形对不超过 x、y 的格子求和. 混合偏导 ∂2F/(∂x∂y) 可恢复联合密度.

积分虚变量 u,v 用来避免与上限 x、y 混淆.

原文笔误:离散情形写成 is give by, 应为 is given by. 这不影响求和公式.

3.5 性质与例 6
3.5 Properties and Example 6

Page 6

The joint cdf F(x,y) of X and Y must satisfy several properties:

  1. F(x,y) is non-decreasing: i.e. if x or y increase then F(x,y) must stay constant or increase.
  2. F(x,y)=0 at the lower-left of the joint range. If the lower left is (−∞,−∞) then this means lim(x,y)→(−∞,−∞)​F(x,y)=0.
  3. F(x,y)=1 at the upper-right of the joint range. If the upper-right is (∞,∞) then this means lim(x,y)→(∞,∞)​F(x,y)=1.

Example 6. Find the joint cdf for the random variables in Example 5.

Solution: The event ‘X≤x and Y≤y’ is a rectangle in the unit square.

F(x,y)=∫0y​∫0x​4uvdudv=x2y2.

对 4uv 积分得到 F(x,y)=x2y2, 其中 0≤x,y≤1. 对它先关于 x、再关于 y 求偏导, 会回到 4xy.

随着 x 或 y 增大, 左下矩形只会扩大, 所以 CDF 不会下降. 取值区域左下端概率为 0, 右上端累积到全部概率 1.

例 7: 离散 CDF
Example 7. A discrete CDF

Pages 6–7

In Example 1, compute F(3.5,4).

Solution: We redraw the joint probability table. Notice how similar the picture is to the one in the previous example. F(3.5,4) is the probability of the event ‘X≤3.5 and Y≤4’. We can visualize this event as the shaded rectangles in the table.

Adding up the probability in the shaded squares we get F(3.5,4)=12/36=1/3.

Note. One unfortunate difference between the continuous and discrete visualizations is that for continuous variables the value increases as we go up in the vertical direction while the opposite is true for the discrete case. We have experimented with changing the discrete tables to match the continuous graphs, but it causes too much confusion. We will just have to live with the difference!

满足 X≤3.5 的骰子值只有 1、2、3, 满足 Y≤4 的值有 1、2、3、4, 共 3⋅4=12 个格子, 概率 12/36=1/3.

易错:坐标图中的 y 向上增大, 而表格的行号通常向下增大. 看图时先确认方向, 不要机械地把「左上」或「左下」从一个图套到另一个图.

CDF 与 pdf 的互相核对. 已知联合密度时, 在左下区域积分得到 F(x,y); 已知联合 CDF 时, 对 x、y 求混合偏导恢复 f(x,y). 边缘 CDF 则把另一个变量放到范围右端.

例如 F(x,y)=x2y2 的混合偏导是 4xy, 与例 5 的密度一致. FX​(x)=F(x,1)=x2, 对应边缘密度 2x, 也能由 ∫01​4xydy=2x 得到.

这种「积分—求导—取边缘」的交叉检查, 能发现积分上下限、系数和变量名错误, 不必另找新的公式.

边缘分布与独立性
Marginal Distributions and Independence

3.6–3.7 边缘分布与边缘 pmf
3.6–3.7 Marginal distributions and marginal pmf

Page 7

When X and Y are jointly-distributed random variables, we may want to consider only one of them, say X. In that case we need to find the pmf (or pdf or cdf) of X without Y. This is called a marginal pmf of the joint pmf (or pdf or cdf).

Example 8. In Example 2 we rolled two dice and let X be the value on the first die and T be the total on both dice. Compute the marginal pmf for X and for T.

Solution: In the table each row represents a single value of X. So the event ‘X=3’ is the third row of the table. To find P(X=3) we simply have to sum up the probabilities in this row. We put the sum in the right-hand margin of the table. Likewise P(T=5) is just the sum of the column with T=5. We put the sum in the bottom margin of the table.

Computing the marginal probabilities P(X=3)=1/6 and P(T=5)=4/36.

As motivated by this example, marginal pmfs are obtained from the joint pmf by summing:

pX​(xi​)=j∑​p(xi​,yj​),pY​(yj​)=i∑​p(xi​,yj​).

The term marginal refers to the fact that the values are written in the margins of the table.

Marginal distribution 边缘分布是只看一个变量时的分布. 离散情形把另一个变量「求和掉」: 行和给出 X 的 pmf, 列和给出 T 的 pmf. 名称正来自写在表格边缘的行和、列和.

这里 P(X=3)=1/6, P(T=5)=4/36=1/9. 联合表包含的信息更多, 单看两张边缘表无法重建所有联合格子.

3.8 边缘 pdf
3.8 Marginal pdf

Page 8

For a continous joint density f(x,y) with range [a,b]×[c,d], the marginal pdfs are:

fX​(x)=∫cd​f(x,y)dy,fY​(y)=∫ab​f(x,y)dx.

Compare these with the marginal pmfs above; as usual the sums are replaced by integrals. We say that to obtain the marginal for X, we integrate out Y from the joint pdf and vice versa.

Example 9. Suppose (X,Y) takes values on the square [0,1]×[1,2] with joint pdf f(x,y)=38​x3y. Find the marginal pdfs fX​(x) and fY​(y).

Solution: To find fX​(x) we integrate out y and to find fY​(y) we integrate out x.

fX​(x)=∫12​38​x3ydy=[34​x3y2]12​=4x3,fY​(y)=∫01​38​x3ydx=[32​x4y]01​=32​y.

连续情形把另一个变量「积分掉」. fX​(x) 是在固定 x 时把所有 y 的密度累加起来, 不是把 y 代成某个特定值.

例 9 得到 fX​(x)=4x3 和 fY​(y)=2y/3. 求 X 的边缘时积分 y, 求 Y 的边缘时积分 x.

原文笔误:For a continous joint density 中的 continous 应为 continuous.

Page 8

Example 10. Suppose (X,Y) takes values on the unit square [0,1]×[0,1] with joint pdf f(x,y)=23​(x2+y2). Find the marginal pdf fX​(x) and use it to find P(X<0.5).

Solution:

fX​(x)=∫01​23​(x2+y2)dy=[23​x2y+2y3​]01​=23​x2+21​.
P(X<0.5)=∫00.5​fX​(x)dx=[21​x3+21​x]00.5​=165​.

例 10 先对 y 积分, 得 fX​(x)=3x2/2+1/2. 再在 [0,1/2] 上积分, 得 P(X<0.5)=5/16.

这与直接在联合区域 X<0.5 上对联合密度积分一致. 边缘 pdf 的作用就是把二维问题化回一维.

3.9 边缘 cdf 与 3D 可视化
3.9 Marginal cdf and 3D visualization

Pages 8–9

Finding the marginal cdf from the joint cdf is easy. If X and Y jointly take values on [a,b]×[c,d] then

FX​(x)=F(x,d),FY​(y)=F(b,y).

If d is ∞ then this becomes a limit FX​(x)=limy→∞​F(x,y). Likewise for FY​(y).

Example 11. The joint cdf in the last example was F(x,y)=21​(x3y+xy3) on [0,1]×[0,1]. Find the marginal cdfs and use FX​(x) to compute P(X<0.5).

Solution: We have FX​(x)=F(x,1)=21​(x3+x) and FY​(y)=F(1,y)=21​(y+y3). So P(X<0.5)=FX​(0.5)=21​(0.53+0.5)=165​: exactly the same as before.

从联合 CDF 取边缘时, 把另一个变量放到取值范围的最右端: FX​(x)=F(x,d), FY​(y)=F(b,y). 若范围无限, 就取极限.

例 11 中 FX​(x)=(x3+x)/2, 所以 FX​(0.5)=5/16, 与边缘 pdf 的结果相同.

3.10 三维可视化
3.10 3D visualization

Page 9

We visualized P(a<X<b) as the area under the pdf f(x) over the interval [a,b]. Since the range of values of (X,Y) is already a two dimensional region in the plane, the graph of f(x,y) is a surface over that region. We can then visualize probability as volume under the surface.

Think: Summoning your inner artist, sketch the graph of the joint pdf f(x,y)=4xy and visualize the probability P(A) as a volume for Example 5.

单变量 pdf 是曲线, 概率是曲线下面积; 两个变量的联合 pdf 是平面区域上的曲面, 概率是曲面在事件区域上方的体积.

4xy 随两个坐标增大而升高, 因此右上区域在概率中权重更大. 这解释了为什么例 5 的事件面积是 1/4, 概率却是 3/16 而不是 1/4.

板书题: 联合分布
Board question: Joint distributions

Slide 13

Suppose X and Y are random variables and

  • (X,Y) takes values in [0,1]×[0,1].
  • the pdf is f(x,y)=x+y.
  1. Show f(x,y) is a valid pdf.
  2. Visualize the event A= ‘X>0.3 and Y>0.5’. Find its probability.

(a) 在正方形内 x+y≥0, 且 ∫01​∫01​(x+y)dxdy=1/2+1/2=1, 所以是合法 pdf.

(b) 事件是矩形 (0.3,1]×(0.5,1]. 概率为 P(A)=∫0.31​∫0.51​(x+y)dydx=∫0.31​(0.5x+0.375)dx=0.49.

Slide 13
  1. Find the cdf F(x,y).
  2. Use the cdf F(x,y) to find the marginal cdf FX​(x) and P(X<0.5).

(c) 在 0≤x,y≤1 内, F(x,y)=∫0x​∫0y​(u+v)dvdu=(x2y+xy2)/2.

(d) 把另一个变量放到范围右端, FX​(x)=F(x,1)=(x2+x)/2, 因而 P(X<0.5)=FX​(0.5)=3/8.

Slides 13–14
  1. Find the marginal pdf fX​(x). Use this to find P(X<0.5).
  2. (New scenario) From the following table compute F(3.5,4).

(e) 可由 fX​(x)=dFX​(x)/dx=x+1/2, 也可由 fX​(x)=∫01​(x+y)dy=x+1/2 得到. 在 [0,1/2] 上积分仍为 3/8.

(f) 新表中 3⋅4=12 个格子, 所以 F(3.5,4)=12/36=1/3. 这与前面的离散 CDF 计数一致.

联合表的三种读法. 每格是 P(X=x,Y=y), 用来求联合事件; 一行或一列相加是边缘分布; 所有格子相加是 1. 联合 CDF 则只保留左下方满足 X≤x,Y≤y 的格子.

从联合表能得到边缘表, 但从两张边缘表通常不能唯一还原联合表. 不同依赖结构可以有相同边缘分布, 所以「知道 X 和 Y 各自的分布」不等于知道它们如何共同变化.

连续情形完全对应: 小区域概率用 f(x,y)dxdy, 边缘密度通过积分另一个变量得到, 联合 CDF 通过左下区域积分得到. 密度常数时, 概率才直接等于「常数 × 面积」.

4 独立性
4 Independence

Page 9

Recall that events A and B are independent if P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B).

Random variables X and Y define events like ‘X≤2’ and ‘Y>5’. So, X and Y are independent if any event defined by X is independent of any event defined by Y. The formal definition that guarantees this is the following.

Definition: Jointly-distributed random variables X and Y are independent if their joint cdf is the product of the marginal cdfs:

F(X,Y)=FX​(x)FY​(y).

For discrete variables this is equivalent to the joint pmf being the product of the marginal pmfs.:

p(xi​,yj​)=pX​(xi​)pY​(yj​).

For continous variables this is equivalent to the joint pdf being the product of the marginal pdfs.:

f(x,y)=fX​(x)fY​(y).

Example 12. For discrete variables independence means the probability in a cell must be the product of the marginal probabilities of its row and column. In the first table this is true: every marginal probability is 1/6 and every cell contains 1/36, i.e. the product of the marginals. Therefore X and Y are independent. In the second table most of the cell probabilities are not the product of the marginal probabilities. For example, none of marginal probabilities are 0, so none of the cells with 0 probability can be the product of the marginals.

Independence 独立性要求联合分布能分解为边缘分布的乘积. 对 CDF 是 F(x,y)=FX​(x)FY​(y), 对离散 pmf 是 p(xi​,yj​)=pX​(xi​)pY​(yj​), 对连续 pdf 是 f(x,y)=fX​(x)fY​(y).

离散表中只要一个格子不满足乘积关系, 就能否定独立性. 例如所有边缘概率都非零时, 联合表中的 0 不可能是两个正数的乘积.

原文笔误:独立性定义把函数值写成了 F(X,Y), 正确应为 F(x,y)=FX​(x)FY​(y), 与前后的自变量一致. 同页 pmfs.: 和 pdfs.: 多一个句点, continous 应为 continuous.

Page 10

Example 13. For continuous variables independence means you can factor the joint pdf or cdf as the product of a function of x and a function of y.

  1. Suppose X has range [0,1/2], Y has range [0,1] and f(x,y)=96x2y3 then X and Y are independent. The marginal densities are fX​(x)=24x2 and fY​(y)=4y3.
  2. If f(x,y)=1.5(x2+y2) over the unit square then X and Y are not independent because there is no way to factor f(x,y) into a product fX​(x)fY​(y).
  3. If F(x,y)=21​(x3y+xy3) over the unit square then X and Y are not independent because the cdf does not factor into a product FX​(x)FY​(y).

连续情形也可看函数能否分离成 g(x)h(y). 96x2y3=(24x2)(4y3), 所以独立.

x2+y2 是两项相加, 不能写成单变量函数的乘积, 所以不独立. 对应 CDF x3y+xy3=xy(x2+y2) 也不能分解.

除了函数形式, 还要注意取值区域是否为矩形乘积; 区域相互约束时通常也不能独立.

概念题: 独立性 I–III
Concept questions: Independence I–III

Slides 16–18

(I) Roll two dice: X= value on first, Y= value on second. Every cell in the joint table is 1/36, and every marginal is 1/6. Are X and Y independent?

(II) Roll two dice: X= value on first, T= sum. Are X and Y independent?

(III) Which of the following joint pdfs are the variables independent? (Each of the ranges is a rectangle chosen so that ∬f(x,y)dxdy=1.)

  1. f(x,y)=4x2y3.
  2. f(x,y)=21​(x3y+xy3).
  3. f(x,y)=6e−3x−2y.

(a) i   (b) ii   (c) iii   (d) i, ii   (e) i, iii   (f) ii, iii   (g) i, ii, iii   (h) None

(I) 独立, 因为 1/36=(1/6)(1/6) 对每个格子成立. (II) 不独立, X 与总和 T 相互约束, 而且表中有边缘概率非零但联合概率为 0 的格子.

(III) 选 (e), 即 (i) 和 (iii). 在矩形取值区域上, 4x2y3 与 6e−3x−2y=(3e−3x)(2e−2y) 都能分解为单变量函数乘积; x3y+xy3=xy(x2+y2) 不能分解.

幻灯片前后不一致:第 (II) 题定义的变量是 X 与 T, 最后却问 Are X and Y independent?. 这里应问 X 与 T 是否独立; 答案仍是“不独立”.

检查独立性的路径. 离散时先算行和、列和, 再逐格比较 p(xi​,yj​) 与 pX​(xi​)pY​(yj​). 只要一格不相等就能判定不独立, 不必继续检查其他格子.

连续时可比较 f(x,y) 与 fX​(x)fY​(y), 也可比较 F(x,y) 与 FX​(x)FY​(y). 若函数能明显分解成单变量函数的乘积, 通常比逐点积分更快.

零概率格是常见的反例入口: 当相关边缘概率都为正时, 联合概率为 0 不可能等于两个正数的乘积. 对连续模型, 还要检查取值区域是否相互约束.

协方差及其计算
Covariance and Its Computation

2 协方差
2 Covariance

2.1 协方差的性质
2.1 Properties of covariance

Page 1

Covariance is a measure of how much two random variables vary together. For example, height and weight of giraffes have positive covariance because when one is big the other tends also to be big.

Definition: Suppose X and Y are random variables with means μX​ and μY​. The covariance of X and Y is defined as

Cov(X,Y)=E[(X−μX​)(Y−μY​)].
  1. Cov(aX+b,cY+d)=acCov(X,Y) for constants a,b,c,d.
  2. Cov(X1​+X2​,Y)=Cov(X1​,Y)+Cov(X2​,Y).
  3. Cov(X,X)=Var(X)
  4. Cov(X,Y)=E[XY]−μX​μY​.
  5. Var(X+Y)=Var(X)+Var(Y)+2Cov(X,Y) for any X and Y.
  6. If X and Y are independent then Cov(X,Y)=0.
    Warning: The converse is false: zero covariance does not always imply independence.

Covariance 协方差是两个变量各自偏离均值后, 偏差乘积的期望. 正号表示同向偏离的趋势, 负号表示反向偏离的趋势, 数值大小还受量纲和尺度影响.

计算时常用 Cov(X,Y)=E[XY]−E[X]E[Y]. 它对每个变量分别线性, 平移 b,d 不改变协方差, 缩放会乘上 ac.

Cov(X,X)=Var(X), 且 Var(X+Y)=Var(X)+Var(Y)+2Cov(X,Y). 独立能推出零协方差, 反向不成立.

例 1: 重叠投掷的协方差
Example 1. Covariance from overlapping coin tosses

Pages 2–3

Flip a fair coin 3 times. Let X be the number of heads in the first 2 flips and let Y be the number of heads on the last 2 flips (so there is overlap on the middle flip). Compute Cov(X,Y).

Solution: We’ll do this twice, first using the joint probability table and the definition of covariance, and then using the properties of covariance.

X∖Y012p(xi​)
01/81/801/4
11/82/81/81/2
201/81/81/4
p(yj​)1/41/21/41

From the marginals we compute E[X]=1=E[Y]. Now we use use the definition:

Cov(X,Y)=E[(X−μX​)(Y−μY​)]=i,j∑​p(xi​,yj​)(xi​−1)(yj​−1).

We write out the sum leaving out all the terms that are 0, i.e. all the terms where xi​=1 or yi​=1 or the probability is 0.

Cov(X,Y)=81​(0−1)(0−1)+81​(2−1)(2−1)=41​.

We could also have used property 4 to do the computation: From the full table we compute E[XY]=5/4. So Cov(X,Y)=E[XY]−μX​μY​=5/4−1=1/4.

联合表给出 E[X]=E[Y]=1 和 E[XY]=5/4, 所以协方差为 5/4−1=1/4.

按定义直接算时, 只有 (0,0) 和 (2,2) 两个格子的偏差乘积非零, 各贡献 1/8, 合计 1/4.

原文笔误:Now we use use the definition 重复了 use, 应为 Now we use the definition. 计算结果 1/4 正确.

Page 3

Next we redo the computation using the properties of covariance. As usual, let Xi​ be the result of the ith flip, so Xi​∼Bernoulli(0.5). We have X=X1​+X2​ and Y=X2​+X3​.

Since the different tosses are independent, only Cov(X2​,X2​)=Var(X2​)=1/4 is nonzero.

更直接的做法是利用重叠结构: X=X1​+X2​, Y=X2​+X3​. 展开后只剩共同项 X2​ 的方差 1/4.

不同投掷相互独立, 所以交叉项 X1​,X2​、X1​,X3​、X2​,X3​ 的协方差都为 0. 后面所有重叠硬币题都可沿用这个思路.

例 2: 零协方差不蕴含独立
Example 2. Zero covariance does not imply independence

Page 3

Let X be a random variable that takes values −2,−1,0,1,2; each with probability 1/5. Let Y=X2. Show that Cov(X,Y)=0 but X and Y are not independent.

Solution: We make a joint probability table:

Y∖X-2-1012p(yj​)
0001/5001/5
101/501/502/5
41/50001/52/5
p(xi​)1/51/51/51/51/51

Using the marginals we compute means E[X]=0 and E[Y]=2.

Next we show that X and Y are not independent. To do this all we have to do is find one place where the product rule fails, i.e. where p(xi​,yj​)=p(xi​)p(xj​):

P(X=−2,Y=0)=0butP(X=−2)⋅P(Y=0)=1/25.

Since these are not equal X and Y are not independent. Finally we compute covariance using Property 4: Cov(X,Y)=51​(−8−1+1+8)−μX​μY​=0.

Discussion: This example shows that Cov(X,Y)=0 does not imply that X and Y are independent. In fact, X and X2 are as dependent as random variables can be: if you know the value of X then you know the value of X2 with 100% certainty.

The key point is that Cov(X,Y) measures the linear relationship between X and Y. In the above example X and X2 have a quadratic relationship that is completely missed by Cov(X,Y).

这里 E[X]=0, E[Y]=2, E[XY]=E[X3]=0, 所以协方差为 0. 可是知道 X 就完全确定了 Y=X2, 两者显然不独立.

乘积规则也直接失败: P(X=−2,Y=0)=0, 而 P(X=−2)P(Y=0)=1/25.

协方差捕捉的是线性趋势. 这个对称的二次关系没有整体向上或向下的直线趋势, 因此协方差看不见它.

原文笔误:乘积规则写成 p(xi​,yj​)=p(xi​)p(xj​), 第二个边缘概率应是 p(yj​), 不是 p(xj​). 下方实际代入的 P(X=−2)P(Y=0)=1/25 使用了正确变量.

例 3: 连续协方差
Example 3. Continuous covariance

Page 4

Suppose X and Y are jointly distributed random variables, with range on the unit square [0,1]×[0,1] and joint pdf f(x,y)=2x3+2y3.

  1. Verify the f(x,y) is a valid probability density.
  2. Compute μX​ and μY​.

Solution: (i) A valid pdf has two properties: it is nonnegative and the total integral over the entire joint range is 1.

Nonnegativity is clear: f(x,y)≥0. The integral is

∫01​∫01​(2x3+2y3)dxdy=1.

Inner integral: ∫01​(2x3+2y3)dx=[x4/2+2xy3]01​=1/2+2y3.

Outer integral: ∫01​(1/2+2y3)dy=[y/2+y4/2]01​=1.

So, the integral over the entire joint range is 1. Thus, f(x,y)=x+y is a valid probability density.

(ii) By symmetry, we know the two means are the same.

μX​=∫01​∫01​(2x4+2xy3)dxdy=2013​,μY​=∫01​∫01​(2yx3+2y4)dxdy=2013​.

正确的密度始终是 2x3+2y3. 它非负且总积分为 1. 两个边缘均值都是 13/20, 由对称性相同.

计算均值时, 一个积分变量乘 x 或 y, 再对联合密度积分. 这里对应 E[X2]=1/2, 后面会用来求方差.

Page 4
  1. Compute the covariance of Cov(X,Y).

(iii) We know Cov(X,Y)=E[(X−μX​)(Y−μY​)]. This is an integral.

Cov(X,Y)=∫01​∫01​(x−13/20)(y−13/20)f(x,y)dxdy
=∫01​∫01​(x−7/12)(y−7/12)(2x3+2y3)dxdy=−4009​.

(In fact, we wrote down the integral in the most straightforward way, but secretly we did the computation by computing E[XY]−E[X]E[Y].)

协方差可用 E[XY]−E[X]E[Y] 计算. 这里 E[XY]=2/5, 所以

Cov(X,Y)=52​−(2013​)2=−4009​.

又有 E[X2]=1/2, 故 Var(X)=1/2−(13/20)2=31/400, 同理 Var(Y)=31/400, 因而相关系数为 (−9/400)/(31/400)=−9/31≈−0.2903.

原文错误:(i) 的结尾把原密度 2x3+2y3 误写成了 x+y, 虽然 x+y 在单位正方形上也能积分为 1, 但它不是本例密度. (iii) 的第二行又把已求得的均值 13/20 写成 7/12; 正确中心化应仍用 13/20. 上述讲解已按原密度和正确均值重算, 最终结果 −9/400 与原文数值一致.

样本散点与相关系数
Sample plots and correlation

3 相关性
3 Correlation

3.1 相关的性质
3.1 Properties of correlation

Page 5

Here’s a plot of the pseudo-random samples generated from this distribution. Because the R code could do it easily, we also include a plot with a more extreme density function.

Samples from f(x,y)=2x3+2y3. Samples from f(x,y)=10x19+10y19.

The units of covariance Cov(X,Y) are ‘units of X times units of Y’. This makes it hard to compare covariances: if we change scales then the covariance changes as well. Correlation is a way to remove the scale from the covariance.

Definition: The correlation coefficient between X and Y is defined by

Cor(X,Y)=ρ=σX​σY​Cov(X,Y)​.
  1. ρ is the covariance of the standardizations of X and Y.
  2. ρ is dimensionless (it’s a ratio!).
  3. −1≤ρ≤1. Furthermore, ρ=+1 if and only if Y=aX+b with a>0, ρ=−1 if and only if Y=aX+b with a<0.

Example 4. We continue Example 1. In Example 1 we found Cov(X,Y)=1/4 and Var(X)=2Var(Xj​)=1/2. So, σX​=1/2​. Likewise σY​=1/2​. Thus Cor(X,Y)=(1/4)/(1/2)=1/2.

Example 5. Look back at Example 3. Var(X)=31/400, so σX​=31/400​≈0.28. Likewise σY​≈0.28. Cor(X,Y)=Cov(X,Y)/(σX​σY​)≈−0.29.

Correlation coefficient 相关系数把协方差除以两个标准差, 从而消除量纲和尺度. 它等价于两个标准化变量的协方差, 范围为 [−1,1].

三次硬币例的相关系数是 (1/4)/(1/2)(1/2)​=1/2; 连续例是 −9/31≈−0.2903. 严格的 ρ=±1 对应几乎必然的线性关系 Y=aX+b, 且要求方差非零, 正负号由 a 决定.

读图:左图样本来自 2x3+2y3, 右图来自更极端的 10x19+10y19. 散点图显示样本关系, 不等同于理论密度曲面.

R 文件用条件分布逐点采样, 理论均值、协方差和相关系数在代码中直接计算. 下面的联合 CDF 是文件中的原样片段:

F = function(x, y, n, a) {
  return ( (x^(n+1)*y + x*y^(n+1))/(n+1) )
}

本机没有 Rscript, 因此没有运行这段 R. Python 代入 n=3,a=2,x=0.3,y=0.4, 原式得 0.00273, 按文件顶部注释补齐 a,b 后得 0.00546, 证明差异不是只写在纸面上的记号问题.

代码错误:R 文件的联合 CDF 漏了系数 a 和 b=compute_b(n,a). 与文件顶部注释一致的正确公式是 F(x,y)=(axn+1y+bxyn+1)/(n+1). 后续采样实际调用的是另一个正确的 `FX` 函数, 没有调用这个 `F`, 所以这不影响文件中后续采样结果.

协方差
Covariance

Slide 19

Measures the degree to which two random variables vary together, e.g. height and weight of people.

  • Positive covariance: When X is bigger than μX​ then Y is ‘usually’ bigger than μY​, and vice versa.
  • Negative covariance: When X is bigger than μX​ then Y is ‘usually’ smaller than μY​, and vice versa.
  • Zero covariance: The sign of X−μX​ tells us nothing about the sign of (Y−μY​).

正、负协方差描述的是平均意义上的同向或反向线性趋势, 「usually」不能读成对每个样本都成立.

零协方差只说明这种线性趋势为 0, 并不说明一个变量完全不能提供另一个变量的信息.

幻灯片错误:零协方差被解释成 X−μX​ 的符号“完全不能提供”Y−μY​ 的符号信息, 说法过强. 零协方差只排除线性关系, 不能排除二次或其他依赖; 紧接着的 Y=X2 反例就说明变量可以完全依赖而协方差仍为 0. 正确说法应限于“没有线性方向信息”.

表格题
Table question

Slide 21

Suppose we have the following joint probability table.

Y∖X-101p(yj​)
001/201/2
11/401/41/2
p(xi​)1/41/21/41

At your table work out the covariance Cov(X,Y). Are X and Y independent?

Covariance = 0. Not independent!

Key point: covariance measures the linear relationship between X and Y. It can completely miss a quadratic or higher order relationship.

这里 Y=∣X∣, E[X]=0, E[Y]=1/2, E[XY]=0, 所以 Cov(X,Y)=0.

但 P(X=0,Y=0)=1/2, 而 P(X=0)P(Y=0)=1/4, 所以不独立. 绝对值关系也能完全避开协方差的线性检测.

零协方差与独立是两条不同的判据. 零协方差只看 E[XY]−E[X]E[Y] 是否为 0; 独立性要求联合分布在每个点都能分解为边缘概率的乘积. 后者强得多.

对称的二次关系 Y=X2 和绝对值关系 Y=∣X∣ 都没有整体直线趋势, 所以协方差为 0. 但给定 X 后 Y 完全确定, 联合表自然不能分解, 因而仍不独立.

所以答题顺序应是: 若协方差非零, 已经能排除独立; 若协方差为 0, 不能下结论, 还要检查联合表或联合密度.

板书题: 协方差与相关
Board question: Covariance and correlation

Slide 23

Flip a fair coin 11 times. (The tosses are all independent.)

Let X= number of heads in the first 6 flips. Let Y= number of heads on the last 6 flips.

Compute Cov(X,Y) and Cor(X,Y).

前 6 次为 1,…,6, 后 6 次为 6,…,11, 只有第 6 次重叠. 展开协方差后只剩 Var(X6​)=1/4. 每个总和有 6 次投掷, 方差都是 6/4=3/2, 因此

Cov(X,Y)=41​,Cor(X,Y)=3/21/4​=61​.

用 Python 枚举全部 211=2048 种投掷结果, 也得到相同结果.

相关散点与重叠求和
Correlation Plots and Overlapping Sums

3.2 二元正态分布
3.2 Bivariate normal distributions

Page 6

The bivariate normal distribution has density

f(x,y)=2πσX​σY​1−ρ2​exp[−2(1−ρ2)1​(σX2​(x−μX​)2​+σY2​(y−μY​)2​−σX​σY​2ρ(x−μX​)(y−μY​)​)]​.

For this distribution, the marginal distributions for X and Y are normal and the correlation between X and Y is ρ.

In the figures below we used R to simulate the distribution for various values of ρ. Individually X and Y are standard normal, i.e. μX​=μY​=0 and σX​=σY​=1. The figures show scatter plots of the results.

These plots and the next set show an important feature of correlation. We divide the data into quadrants by drawing a horizontal and a verticle line at the means of the y data and x data respectively. A positive correlation corresponds to the data tending to lie in the 1st and 3rd quadrants. A negative correlation corresponds to data tending to lie in the 2nd and 4th quadrants. You can see the data gathering about a line as ρ becomes closer to ±1.

二元正态由两个均值、两个标准差和相关系数 ρ 共同决定. 本页两个边缘分布都是标准正态, 但联合形状随 ρ 改变: 正相关点云沿右上方向聚集, 负相关沿左上到右下方向聚集, ∣ρ∣ 越接近 1, 点云越贴近直线.

读图:横线、竖线按均值划分象限. 正相关主要落在第一、第三象限, 负相关主要落在第二、第四象限. ρ=1 时样本完全落在正斜率直线上; ρ=−0.9 则呈明显的负斜率细带点.

原文笔误:verticle line 应为 vertical line. 二元正态公式和图示的 ρ 含义一致.

点云形状与 ρ 的关系. ρ=0 表示没有线性方向, 不是点云一定呈圆形, 也不代表独立; ρ 越接近 ±1, 点云越贴近一条直线, 正负号决定斜率方向.

散点图只是有限样本, 会受到随机波动影响. 读图时以理论 ρ 为基准, 不要求每次 sample_cor 与理论值完全相等.

3.3 重叠的均匀分布求和
3.3 Overlapping uniform distributions

Pages 7–8

We ran simulations in R of the following scenario. X1​,X2​,…,X20​ are i.i.d and follow a U(0,1) distribution. X and Y are both sums of the same number of Xi​. We call the number of Xi​ common to both X and Y the overlap. The notation in the figures below indicates the number of Xi​ being summed and the number which overlap. For example, 5,3 indicates that X and Y were each the sum of 5 of the Xi​ and that 3 of the Xi​ were common to both sums. (The data was generated using rand(1,1000);)

Using the linearity of covariance it is easy to compute the theoretical correlation. For each plot we give both the theoretical correlation and the correlation of the data from the simulated sample.

设 X、Y 各求和 r 个独立 U(0,1) 变量, 其中有 s 个共同项. 展开协方差后只有共同项保留, 所以 Cov(X,Y)=s/12; 两边方差各为 r/12, 因而 Cor(X,Y)=s/r.

六幅图的理论值依次为 0,1/2,1/5,3/5,1/2,4/5. 图上的 sample_cor 是具体随机样本的估计, 会有抽样波动, 不要求与理论值完全相等.

原文笔误:讲义说模拟使用 R, 却写成 MATLAB 风格的 rand(1,1000). 配套 R 脚本实际使用的是 `runif`, 因此这里应理解为笔误, 不应把 `rand(1,1000)` 当作可运行的 R 代码.

重叠求和与更多投掷
Overlapping sums and even more tosses

Slides 26–29

We made two random variables X and Y from overlapping sums of uniform random variables. For example:

X=X1​+X2​+X3​+X4​+X5​,Y=X3​+X4​+X5​+X6​+X7​.

These are sums of 5 of the Xi​ with 3 in common. If we sum r of the Xi​ with s in common we name it (r,s).

Intuition check. Toss a fair coin 2n+1 times. Let X be the number of heads on the first n+1 tosses and Y the number on the last n+1 tosses. If n=1000 then Cov(X,Y) is: (a) 0   (b)1/4   (c)1/2   (d) 1   (e) More than 1   (f) tiny but not 0.

Board question. Toss a fair coin 2n+1 times. Let X be the number of heads on the first n+1 tosses and Y the number on the last n+1 tosses. Compute Cov(X,Y) and Cor(X,Y).

前 n+1 次与后 n+1 次只有正中间一次投掷重叠. 无论 n 多大, 共同项始终只有一个 Bernoulli 变量, 所以协方差始终是 1/4, 直觉题选 (b).

两边各自包含 n+1 次投掷, 方差都是 (n+1)/4, 因此 Cor(X,Y)=1/(n+1). 当 n=1000 时, 协方差仍为 1/4, 相关系数降为 1/1001: 单项重叠在越来越大的总和中被稀释.

重叠求和的一般公式. 设 X=A+C, Y=B+C, 其中 A、B、C 由相互独立的变量组成, C 是共同部分. 展开协方差后, A 与 B 的所有交叉项都为 0, 只剩 Cov(X,Y)=Var(C).

若 X、Y 各含 r 个同分布独立项, 共同部分含 s 项, 每个方差为 v, 则 Cov(X,Y)=sv, 而 Var(X)=Var(Y)=rv, 所以相关系数为 s/r.

Bernoulli 中 v=1/4, 均匀 U(0,1) 中 v=1/12, 正好对应笔记里的两个系列. 重叠项数固定时, 总项数 r 增大, 协方差不变, 相关系数却被稀释.

现实中的相关与因果
Real-life correlations and causation

Slides 24–25
  • Over time, amount of ice cream consumption is correlated with number of pool drownings.
  • In 1685 (and today) being a student is the most dangerous profession. That is, the average age of those who die is less than any other profession.
  • In 90% of bar fights ending in a death the person who started the fight died.
  • Hormone replacement therapy (HRT) is correlated with a lower rate of coronary heart disease (CHD).

Edward Tufte: ”Empirically observed covariation is a necessary but not sufficient condition for causality.”

冰淇淋销量与溺水人数可能共同受炎热天气影响; 学生群体的死亡平均年龄低, 主要因为学生本身年轻, 不能推出「学生是最危险职业」; 斗殴记录的分类、报案和双方行为都可能影响统计, 不能只看一句相关描述判定因果.

HRT 与较低 CHD 率的观察性关联也可能受健康使用者效应、社会经济状况和就医行为影响. 评估治疗是否有效需要更可靠的研究设计, 不能把相关当成治疗有效的证据.

「相关是因果的必要而非充分条件」强调: 因果通常会产生某种共同变化, 但观察到共同变化并不能唯一确定因果方向或机制.

从相关到因果还缺什么. 相关只说明变量共同变化, 不能单独确定方向. 可能是 X 影响 Y, 也可能是 Y 影响 X, 还可能有共同原因 Z 同时影响两者, 或样本选择造成了表面关联.

冰淇淋与溺水提示共同天气因素; 学生死亡平均年龄提示年龄结构; HRT 提示健康使用者效应和就医行为. 这些替代解释必须在作因果结论前逐项排除.

相关系数的大小也不能直接表示因果效应大小. 它先受模型、量纲以外的标准化和样本设计影响. 评估治疗或政策时, 需要对照组、随机化、自然实验或其他识别策略.

4 协方差与相关性质的证明
4 Proof of the properties of covariance and correlation

Page 9

1 and 2 follow from similar properties for expected value.

3. This is the definition of variance: Cov(X,X)=E[(X−μX​)(X−μX​)]=E[(X−μX​)2]=Var(X).

4. Recall that E[X−μX​]=0. So

Cov(X,Y)=E[XY]−μX​E[Y]−μY​E[X]+μX​μY​=E[XY]−μX​μY​.

5. Using properties 3 and 2 we get

Var(X+Y)=Cov(X+Y,X+Y)=Var(X)+Var(Y)+2Cov(X,Y).

6. If X and Y are independent then f(x,y)=fX​(x)fY​(y). Therefore

Cov(X,Y)=∫(x−μX​)fX​(x)dx∫(y−μY​)fY​(y)dy=E[X−μX​]E[Y−μY​]=0.

协方差公式 E[XY]−μX​μY​ 来自展开偏差乘积并用 E[X−μX​]=E[Y−μY​]=0.

独立性使二重积分分成两个单变量积分的乘积, 两个因子都为 0, 所以独立变量的协方差为 0. 这也解释了为什么独立时 Var(X+Y) 退化为方差直接相加.

4.2 相关性质 3 的证明
4.2 Proof of Property 3 of correlation

Page 9

(This is for the mathematically interested.)

0≤Var(σX​X​−σY​Y​)=2−2ρ.

This implies ρ≤1. Likewise 0≤Var(X/σX​+Y/σY​), so −1≤ρ.

If ρ=1 then 0=Var(X/σX​−Y/σY​)⇒X/σX​−Y/σY​=c.

标准化变量的方差为 1, 因此 Var(X/σX​−Y/σY​)=2−2ρ≥0, 得到 ρ≤1; 把减号换加号得到 ρ≥−1.

等号成立时, 相应标准化和或差的方差为 0, 所以变量几乎必然呈线性关系. 再由两边均值为 0 可确定常数项, 并区分正斜率与负斜率.

协方差计算流程. 先求 E[X] 和 E[Y], 再求 E[XY], 最后用 E[XY]−E[X]E[Y]. 若变量有明显的重叠结构, 也可以先展开并消去独立交叉项, 通常比列完整联合表更快.

得到协方差后, 若要相关系数, 再分别求 Var(X) 和 Var(Y), 用 ρ=Cov(X,Y)/(σX​σY​). 两个标准差都在分母, 不能只除以一个.

最后做方向检查: 同向变化通常对应正号, 反向变化对应负号. 但零协方差只排除线性趋势, 不能据此宣布独立, 必须回到联合分布的乘积判据.
